official: 町田市乳児等通園支援事業の設備及び運営の基準に関する条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年6月定例会（第2回） 議案一覧

name: 通園支援事業所の職員規定などを改正
summary: 条例では、乳児等通園支援事業の職員や運営に関する基準を定めています。この議案は、職員や利用定員に関する規定を改め、児童対象性暴力等を防ぐための犯罪事実確認などを事業者に求めます。条例は公布日から施行し、児童対象性暴力等に関する改正は2026年12月25日から施行します。
changes: 職員に関する規定の表現を、事業者単位から事業所単位に改める
児童対象性暴力等の防止と発生時の保護に向け、犯罪事実確認などを事業者に求める
運営規程に定める利用定員を、乳児・幼児別から全体の定員に改める
余裕活用型の事業定義や規定の準用、電磁的記録に関する表現を改める
who: 乳児等通園支援事業を利用する乳幼児と保護者
乳児等通園支援事業者と職員

en.name: Revises staff and other rules for childcare attendance support services
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Machida City Ordinance on Standards for the Facilities and Operation of Infant and Other Child Attendance Support Services
en.summary: The ordinance sets standards for staff and the operation of infant and other child attendance support services. This bill revises provisions on staff and user capacity, and requires providers to conduct criminal-record checks and take other measures to prevent sexual violence against children and protect them if it occurs. The ordinance will take effect on the date of promulgation. The amendments concerning sexual violence against children will take effect on December 25, 2026.
changes: Change the wording of staff-related provisions from applying at the provider level to applying at the facility level
Require providers to conduct criminal-record checks and take other measures to prevent sexual violence against children and protect them if it occurs
Change the user capacity in the operating rules from separate capacities for infants and toddlers to a single total capacity
Revise the definition of the flexible-use model, provisions applied mutatis mutandis, and wording concerning electronic records
who: Infants and toddlers who use the services
Parents and guardians of infants and toddlers who use the services
Providers of infant and other child attendance support services
Staff of infant and other child attendance support services
